command:
set -eu
if ! getent passwd clusterops >/dev/null 2>&1; then useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash clusterops; fi
passwd -l clusterops >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
clusterops_group=$(id -gn clusterops)
install -d -m 700 -o clusterops -g "$clusterops_group" /home/clusterops/.ssh
hosts_tmp=$(mktemp /tmp/ssh-cluster-hosts.XXXXXX)
awk '{ drop=0; for (i=2; i<=NF; i++) if ($i=="node1" || $i=="node2" || $i=="node3") drop=1; if (!drop) print }' /etc/hosts > "$hosts_tmp"
{
  cat "$hosts_tmp"
  printf '%s\n' '# BEGIN ANTRIEB SSH CLUSTER HOSTS'
  printf '%s\n' "$CLUSTER_HOSTS"
  printf '%s\n' '# END ANTRIEB SSH CLUSTER HOSTS'
} > "$hosts_tmp.new"
install -o root -g root -m 644 "$hosts_tmp.new" /etc/hosts
rm -f "$hosts_tmp" "$hosts_tmp.new"
key_file=/home/clusterops/.ssh/id_ed25519
if [ ! -s "$key_file" ] || [ ! -s "$key_file.pub" ]; then
  rm -f "$key_file" "$key_file.pub"
  runuser -u clusterops -- ssh-keygen -q -t ed25519 -f "$key_file" -N '' -C "clusterops@$NODE_NAME"
fi
chmod 600 "$key_file"
chmod 644 "$key_file.pub"
chown clusterops:"$clusterops_group" "$key_file" "$key_file.pub"
printf 'NODE=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME"
printf 'PUBLIC_KEY='
cat "$key_file.pub"
